:::{#thm-score-mean-zero}
#### Mean of the score

Let $\vX$ be a continuous random vector with density $\p(\vx \mid \param)$
for a scalar parameter $\param$.
Suppose the set of possible data values does not depend on $\param$,
and the order of differentiation with respect to $\param$
and integration over the data can be exchanged.
Then the [score](#def-score) $\score$,
the derivative of the log-likelihood with respect to $\param$,
has expectation zero:

$$\E{\score} = 0$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-score-mean-zero, worked in @sol-score-mean-zero.
It builds on @lem-deriv-log-density.

:::
